summary: The second SailAway 2 game of the bluegecko 3v1 series: three islet seats under one Opus 5.5 medium player against thebluegecko (Cortex), lost by resignation at 14:47 on the host's suggestion. Every seat opened with a shipyard (1:09-1:23), and when the hands refused every construction ship's extractor step (a since-fixed defect: ships had no distance field from a land start), the player decided the islet spots were out of ships' reach and also put a 670-metal hover platform on every seat. So orange held 3 extractors and red 2 for the whole game, and the side's income was 35 at 8:00. From 4:09 the yards were held to 280-range Dolphins and Supporters, even after the first Riptide (480) at 4:50 and the report's 'it outranges everything here' at 5:32, and the 7:22 push on a seen-metal lead went as three pieces and was sunk in our own water and at his yard 8:31-9:45. He then killed two commanders with Riptides and unseen Orcas (10:25, 11:35) and finished the last base with Cutlass seaplanes (13:08-14:27); no sonar tower stood and no anti-air was ordered until 13:32.

root.what: The side's economy was capped in the opening. Every seat had spent 450 on a shipyard first (1:09-1:23), and its first units were construction ships. At 2:21-2:33 the hands refused all their extractor steps (harness: no ship distance field from a land start). At 2:34 the player wrote ships off for expansion (tidals, converters, assist) and ordered a 670 hover platform per seat, then paused the yards at 3:19 with 0 metal on every seat. Orange and red never expanded. The person's reading (the user) puts the cause here; the existing review's 4:50 boat-choice root is the decisive turning point that followed.

their_play: thebluegecko (Cortex; commander never seen; base and shipyard at C2/C3, a radar/sonar tower at D3 by 7:05) played the sea by reach. He opened with a two-Supporter raid on our weakest seat's home water (red, C7, 3:56). Riptides followed from 4:50: 21 distinct ones over the game, about 8.8k metal by the review's count. He kept them as the main body, fighting in our water (E6, D7, F7, F8) from 480 against our 280 and taking our fleet piece by piece. He added Orca subs from 9:23, unseen without sonar, behind the Riptides. From 9:05 a seaplane platform and construction seaplanes gave Cutlasses at 10:04, and seven of them with four Riptides finished the last base. At 12:58 a Guard light turret was planted at red's harbor to kill its extractors. No tier-2 land factory was seen. His true economy and army are unknown (no truth file).

bears_on.note: The 7:22 fleet never went as one body. Orange's group held at D7, dark purple's Dolphins died at E6 8:31-8:45, and red's 13 Supporters died alone at C3 9:10-9:45. Our player at 14:39: 'the fleet was fed in pieces'.

This bounds the lesson: the lead was used at 7:22, but it was counted in seen metal ('we outweigh everything of his we have seen') against a fleet that outranged ours 480 to 280. A lead that ignores reach and the unseen part of his army was no lead.
'pre emptively go air' / scout and answer air early: the seaplane platform was seen at 9:05, but anti-air was first ordered at 13:32, and Cutlasses killed 4.7k and finished the base.
Tidals went up first on every seat (0:48-1:03; 31 in all), but metal, not energy, bound this game: at 3:19 energy was full at 4703 (+484) with 0 metal, and the player turned to 17 converters.
The reader's reading, no person's: each layer he added was one we had no answer to. Riptides came against 280-range boats, Orcas against no sonar, and seaplanes against no anti-air.

tools: scratch scans of record-0..2 (extractors, income, builds, losses by killer, first sightings) and strategist-0.jsonl (instructs, produce, report lines, player text)
lens.caveats: No truth file, batch.json or results.jsonl: his numbers are what our seats saw (floors), and analyze_match/floor report 'outcome None after 0.0 min'. minutes.py, analyze_match, floor and raid_ledger read record-0 only (orange, F7); side-wide numbers come from my scans of all three records. pro_baseline was not run: the map is SailAway 2 despite the batch name, and the pool has no SailAway cards. My records scan's extractor counts include frames (dark purple 12 at 8:00, the side 17, matching the eco line), where the review counts 14 finished. My loss totals include frames, so for finished units I cite the review (29.0k, Riptides 16.5k). Where I differ from review.md: it ranks the 4:50 boat choice as the root and the opening economy as a checked cost. I put the root at 2:21-2:34 on the user's later reading and the refusals in the record. The boat choice remains the decisive turning point.
